13:00.headline: Do grades really matter?
13:00.topic: Recruiting Reality Check: GPA and academic fit (D3 no athletic aid, D1/D2 core courses, coaches ask GPA)

captions.instagram:
Recruiting Reality Check: do grades really matter in baseball recruiting?

Yes, and often more than families expect.

⚾ Good grades widen his list. More schools are realistic options.
⚾ D3 programs don't offer athletic scholarships, so academic aid can matter a lot.
⚾ D1 and D2 have NCAA academic eligibility standards, including core courses.
⚾ Coaches commonly ask for GPA early, often in recruiting questionnaires.

His GPA is a recruiting number, just like his 60 or his velo. Save this for the next report card conversation.

Have a recruiting question? Send it to us for a future Reality Check.

captions.facebook:
Recruiting Reality Check: do grades really matter, or is it all about the numbers on the field?

Grades matter, and here's why parents should treat GPA like any other recruiting number:

✅ Strong grades widen the list of realistic schools.
✅ NCAA Division III schools don't offer athletic scholarships, so academic aid and admission can carry a lot of weight.
✅ D1 and D2 have NCAA academic eligibility standards, including core-course requirements, so it's worth checking his schedule with his school counselor now.
✅ Coaches commonly ask for GPA early, often on recruiting questionnaires and in first conversations.

None of this replaces his play on the field. But a player with solid grades gives coaches one less reason to hesitate.
